bandGrades.countingRule: n = harness-fired requests in that tier. 200_rate = count(status==200)/n. Percentiles on all completed responses. Outside a pre-registered band is a finding either way.

findings.what: first_429_cumulative=72 is outside pre-registered [50,70] for a 60 rpm cap.
findings.why: checkRateLimit uses minuteBucket = Math.floor(now/60000) (calendar UTC minute), not a sliding 60s from first request (hauska-mcp-server/src/rate-limit.ts). HAUSKA_FREE_IP_RPM is unset on 00063-fic so default 60 applies. A 20s 1 rps ramp that straddles :00 UTC admits leftover of the prior minute plus a fresh 60, which is how 71 HTTP 200s landed before the first 429.
findings.not: Silent memory fallback. Health 36/36 primary=postgres memory_fallback=false. 429 body band=rpm. 20 rps after cap = 301/301 HTTP 429. Zero HTTP 503.
findings.doNotTune: 72 is the measurement. The cap is still 60 per wall-clock minute per IP.
